none: PAS LEIC-B9A082: Roman copper alloy spoon
contea di ritrovamento: Leicestershire (Inghilterra e Galles)

Roman copper alloy spoon, 109mm long, 31mm wide and 14mm thick with a weight of 12.06grams. The object consists of an incomplete spoon bowl which would have had an ovoid form. Its handle is almost complete. The 'neck' joining the two parts consists of an openwork sub rectangular attachment. It emerges from just below the rim of the bowl, running outwards from it for about 10mm. This is decorated with a ring and dot depression next to the bowl, followed by a line of semi-circular stamps. It then turns upwards, c.10mm, where it joins the handle. The line of stamps continues over the end of the handle in a diagonal alignment ending at its upper surface.
